purpose: Teach: プラント/穀物/浪費/感銘/共著/人文/宣告/未成年

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の新プラント、環境基準、最高水準で、設計させろ。
lines.en: I want our new plant designed to the highest environmental standards.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear enunciation on each element. No hesitation—this is a set principle being restated. Steady eye contact throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。穀物加工の食品事業、新規参入、検討中です、来期から。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently evaluating grain-processing as a new food business division for next fiscal year.
lines.style: Respectful, precise delivery. Slight forward lean in posture. Each fact placed carefully, like laying out a report. Calm and thorough.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資源浪費、社内、絶対に、許さない方針だ、徹底させろ。
lines.en: Resource waste will not be tolerated inside this company. Make sure that's driven home.
lines.style: Direct, firm. Weight on the negation. Tempo slightly quickened to convey urgency without raising volume. Steady intensity throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者のスピーチ、新人、感銘を、受けたって、伝えてきました。
lines.en: Yes. I've already told the new staff that the founder's speech made a real impression on them.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formality. Slight pride in the observation. Natural pacing, conversational but still measured. A small nod of acknowledgment in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界誌で、大学教授と、共著、新人にも、機会、与えろ。
lines.en: I want the new staff given opportunities to work on pieces like the industry journal article I'm co-authoring with that university professor.
lines.style: Expectant, directive tone. Measured pace but with clear intent. Opening attack is firm. This is a deliberate investment, so conviction sits behind each phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。人文系出身の社員も、活躍の場、広がっております。
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing more humanities-background staff finding meaningful roles here.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the voice. Unhurried pacing. Slight uplift at the end—genuine approval, not performed. Warm but professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 破産宣告を、受けた競合の事例、研究して、反面教師に、しろ。
lines.en: Study the cases of competitors who've filed for bankruptcy. Learn from their mistakes so we don't repeat them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Opens quietly, like he's sharing something earned from experience. Slow pace, each phrase weighted. The tone of someone teaching, not just commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。未成年向け、製品安全基準、見直しております、最高基準で。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing all product safety standards for the under-eighteen market—everything to the highest level.
lines.style: Firm resolve in the voice. Measured, respectful delivery. Slight emphasis on the safety commitment. Closing the conversation with a note of quiet conviction.
